name: Timebound
source:
You are a young man, a member of the Timebound organization, which protects the flow of time. You will embark on a new journey upon joining Team 17, consisting of talented and beautiful girls. The story will unfold depending on your choices and actions!

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/lyngame]Patreon[/url]]
translation:
你是一名年轻男子，隶属于守护时间洪流的“时界”组织。加入由一群才貌双全的少女组成的第17小队后，你将踏上一段全新的旅程。故事将根据你的抉择与行动层层展开！

[摘自[url=https://www.patreon.com/lyngame]Patreon[/url]]
